Specifications.Included High-Pass Filter: Passive 350 Hz high-pass filter built-in to protect against damage from frequencies below operational range.

Specifications.Maximum SPL (1m): 117 dB cont ave. (123 dB peak), 1 kHz – 6 kHz;123 dB cont ave. (129 dB peak), 2 kHz, 15W input,8 ohm setting

Specifications.Drivers: 33 mm (1.3 in) diameter with phenolic diaphragm
